# Bookflow

> Multi-company double-entry accounting for small businesses, one command set reached as a Python library, a CLI, an HTTP host with a browser workbench, and MCP. People and AI agents work in the same books under the same rules.

An AI agent installing Bookflow for someone needs two shell commands and one MCP call:

1. `uv tool install git+https://github.com/5000Stadia/bookflow` (or `pipx install git+https://github.com/5000Stadia/bookflow`); Python 3.12 or newer.
2. `bookflow setup --company "Their Company" --currency USD --owner them --owner-name "Their Name" --json`, run in the folder whose `.mcp.json` the MCP client reads. It creates the books, the company, the agent's own identity working for the owner, the MCP configuration, a one-time password link for the owner, and starts the host.
3. Reload the MCP client and call `bookflow_run` with `{"command": "company show", "input": {}}`.

## Docs

- [Agent install](docs/agent-install.md): the steps above in full, and what to tell the owner
- [MCP guide](docs/mcp-guide.md): the three MCP tools, files, receipts and recovery
